description: Venues the two Package 07 sweeps surfaced that Package 06 did not hold. Each names the source family that found it. Finding few or none is the expected outcome of a closure package.

venues.name: Aberdeen Sports Village (Chris Anderson Stadium)
venues.operator_name: Aberdeen Sports Village (University of Aberdeen / Aberdeen City Council / sportscotland partnership)
venues.capacity_context: Outdoor Chris Anderson Stadium: a stand seating 500 spectators overlooking the 400m track, jumps/throws areas and full-size football pitch. This is the scottishathletics 2026 National Senior and U18 Championships venue.

identity_evidence.note: Official ASV athletics facility page identifies Chris Anderson Stadium, 400m outdoor track plus indoor facility, home of Aberdeen Amateur Athletics Club (AAAC).

capacity_evidence.note: Quote: 'a stand seating 500 spectators to enjoy the view across' the track and field areas.

venues.discovered_by_source_family: scottishathletics National Championships venue rotation (confirmed as 2026 Senior/U18 Championships host)
venues.notes: Surfaced by walking the scottishathletics championship-venue rotation (Grangemouth / Scotstoun / Aberdeen). Not present in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt or ATHLETICS-BASELINE.txt. Directly fetched official page gives a firm below-threshold seated stand figure of 500; no other capacity claim found anywhere. [New in Package 07, discovered by scottishathletics National Championships venue rotation (confirmed as 2026 Senior/U18 Championships host) (researcher b). Canonical reconciliation: no canonical venue matched by exact name, name+locality, corroborated website host, or distinctive name core.]

venues.name: Sheffield Hallam University City Athletics Stadium

identity_evidence.note: Official SHU page: 'Sheffield Hallam University City Athletics Stadium', Woodbourn Road, Sheffield S9 3HL; 8-lane track with 10-lane home straight; describes 'spectator seating' but gives no figure; currently access-restricted to supervised coaching only, not open for independent training/competition.
Describes Woodbourn Road as 'the city's smaller Woodbourn Road Athletics Stadium' relative to Don Valley Stadium (25,000/50,000 capacity) — explicitly smaller, but no number given.

venues.discovered_by_source_family: Successor-venue check after Don Valley Stadium's 2013 closure/2014 demolition; cross-referenced against Athletics Weekly 'Top 10 UK athletics stadiums' feature
venues.notes: Regional successor athletics facility to the closed Don Valley Stadium; home of City of Sheffield & Dearne AC (a National Athletics League club). Not present in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt. Two further pages that might have carried a capacity figure (shu.ac.uk/business/event-services/venues/city-athletics-stadium and an accessable.co.uk access guide) returned HTTP 404 and 403 respectively on fetch — a tool limit, not a negative finding. Not among the rotating UK Athletics national championship venues. Genuinely unresolved rather than confirmed either side of 1,000; not promoted to CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS absent a fetched capacity figure, per the ABSOLUTE RULES. [New in Package 07, discovered by Successor-venue check after Don Valley Stadium's 2013 closure/2014 demolition; cross-referenced against Athletics Weekly 'Top 10 UK athletics stadiums' feature (researcher b). Canonical reconciliation: no canonical venue matched by exact name, name+locality, corroborated website host, or distinctive name core.]
